cap: The left panel shows why the route matters: swallowed estrogen reaches the liver at high concentration and raises clotting factors, triglycerides, binding globulins and gallstone risk, while transdermal estradiol enters the circulation directly. The right panel shows why the uterus matters: estrogen alone drives the endometrium toward hyperplasia and cancer, so a woman with a uterus adds a progestogen, and low-dose vaginal estrogen for local symptoms needs none.
